entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date of arrival in Haiti.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Haití.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Tourists must pay an entry fee of 10 US dollars in cash on arrival.
entry.es: Los turistas deben pagar en efectivo una tasa de entrada de 10 dólares estadounidenses al llegar.
entry.quote: Tourists must pay an entry fee of 10 US dollars in cash on arrival.

entry.en: Tourists must pay a departure tax of 55 US dollars, which is included in the ticket price for most international flights.
entry.es: Los turistas deben pagar una tasa de salida de 55 dólares estadounidenses, incluida en el billete en la mayoría de vuelos internacionales.
entry.quote: Tourists must pay a departure tax of 55 US dollars. For most international flights, this is included in the price of the ticket.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde un país de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Citizens of most countries can enter Haiti without a visa, except for a list including Colombia, Cuba and the Dominican Republic.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos de la mayoría de países pueden entrar en Haití sin visado, salvo una lista que incluye Colombia, Cuba y República Dominicana.
entry.quote: Visa-free privileges are not extended to citizens of Colombia, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Iran, Libya, Panama, Syria, Vietnam and Yemen.

safety.en: The border between Haiti and the Dominican Republic is closed to travellers and its status may change at short notice.
safety.es: La frontera entre Haití y la República Dominicana está cerrada a los viajeros y su situación puede cambiar con poco aviso.
safety.quote: The border between Haiti and the Dominican Republic is closed to travellers. The status of the border remains subject to change at short notice.

safety.en: The security situation is unpredictable and crime levels are high.
safety.es: La situación de seguridad es impredecible y los niveles de delincuencia son altos.
safety.quote: The security situation is unpredictable and crime levels are high.

safety.en: There is a high threat of criminal kidnaps in Haiti, which can occur in any part of the country at any time.
safety.es: Hay una alta amenaza de secuestros criminales en Haití, que pueden ocurrir en cualquier parte del país y en cualquier momento.
safety.quote: There is a high threat of criminal kidnaps in Haiti. Incidents of criminal kidnap can occur in any part of the country, at any time.

safety.en: Gangs, often on motorbikes, target people making cash machine withdrawals or leaving banks, particularly those on foot.
safety.es: Bandas, a menudo en moto, atacan a quienes retiran dinero de cajeros o salen de bancos, sobre todo a pie.
safety.quote: Gangs, often on motorbikes, target people making withdrawals or leaving banks, particularly those travelling on foot.

safety.en: Road travel is highly dangerous, with armed carjacking common and improvised road blocks used to extort or kidnap motorists.
safety.es: Viajar por carretera es muy peligroso, con robos de coches a mano armada frecuentes y bloqueos improvisados usados para extorsionar o secuestrar.
safety.quote: Road travel is highly dangerous. Armed carjacking is common and criminal groups often use improvised road blocks to extort or kidnap motorists.

safety.en: The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June to November, and earthquakes are a risk in Haiti.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes del Atlántico va de junio a noviembre, y los terremotos son un riesgo en Haití.
safety.quote: The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June to November.

health.en: Medical services are extremely limited, easily overwhelmed and offer a poor standard of care.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son extremadamente limitados, se saturan fácilmente y ofrecen una atención de baja calidad.
health.quote: Medical services are extremely limited, easily overwhelmed and offer a poor standard of care.

health.en: Doctors and hospitals generally expect immediate cash payment for care even with valid travel health insurance.
health.es: Los médicos y hospitales suelen esperar el pago inmediato en efectivo aunque se tenga un seguro de viaje válido.
health.quote: Doctors and hospitals generally expect immediate cash payment for care even if you have a proof of a valid travel health insurance.

health.en: Medicines sold in Haiti may be poor quality and pharmacies may sell expired medicines.
health.es: Los medicamentos vendidos en Haití pueden ser de mala calidad y las farmacias pueden vender medicamentos caducados.
health.quote: Medicines sold in Haiti may be poor quality and pharmacies may sell expired medicines.

health.en: Tap water should be avoided and only bottled water should be drunk.
health.es: Se debe evitar el agua del grifo y beber solo agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water should be avoided. Drink bottled water only.

health.en: Malaria is common and most travellers will need anti-malarial drugs, and dengue fever is also fairly common.
health.es: La malaria es frecuente y la mayoría de los viajeros necesitarán antipalúdicos, y el dengue también es bastante común.
health.quote: Malaria is common and most travellers will need anti-malarial drugs. Dengue fever is also fairly common.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Haiti are 116 for ambulance, 115 for fire and 122 for police, though services may face long delays.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Haití son el 116 para ambulancia, el 115 para bomberos y el 122 para policía, aunque los servicios pueden tardar mucho.

help.en: Emergency services may be unable to respond or face long delays in reaching you due to the security situation.
help.es: Los servicios de emergencia pueden no poder responder o tardar mucho en llegar debido a la situación de seguridad.
help.quote: emergency services may be unable to respond or face long delays in reaching you.

getting_in.en: International travellers arrive at Port-au-Prince (PAP) or Cap-Haïtien (CAP) airports.
getting_in.es: Los viajeros internacionales llegan a los aeropuertos de Puerto Príncipe (PAP) o Cabo Haitiano (CAP).
getting_in.quote: International travelers will arrive in Haiti at Port-au-Prince (PAP IATA) at the Aéroport Toussaint L'Ouverture or Aéroport International Cap-Haïtien (CAP IATA) in the North.

getting_in.en: American Airlines and JetBlue serve Port-au-Prince from the US.
getting_in.es: American Airlines y JetBlue unen Puerto Príncipe con Estados Unidos.
getting_in.quote: Airlines such as American Airlines, and JetBlue, serve Port-au-Prince from the US.

getting_in.en: Flights offer a safe passage into and out of Port-au-Prince compared with the dangerous public transport by bus and tap-tap.
getting_in.es: Los vuelos ofrecen un acceso seguro a Puerto Príncipe frente al transporte público peligroso en autobús y tap-tap.
getting_in.quote: flights offer a safe passage into and out of Port-au-Prince from other parts in Haiti.

getting_in.en: There is a crowded border crossing with the Dominican Republic at Dajabón/Ouanaminthe, open only during the day.
getting_in.es: Hay un paso fronterizo concurrido con la República Dominicana en Dajabón/Ouanaminthe, abierto solo de día.
getting_in.quote: There is also a crowded border crossing between the Dominican Republic and Haiti in Dajabón/Ouanaminthe. The border is open only during the day.

getting_around.en: Taxis in Haiti are usually SUVs or trucks because many roads need repair, and they offer more safety and comfort than tap-taps or buses.
getting_around.es: Los taxis en Haití suelen ser SUV o camionetas porque muchas carreteras necesitan reparación, y ofrecen más seguridad y comodidad que tap-taps o autobuses.
getting_around.quote: Taxis in Haiti are usually in the form of SUVs or trucks, as most of the roads are long overdue for repairs

getting_around.en: Tap-taps are modified trucks or vans and are the most economical way to travel in Haiti.
getting_around.es: Los tap-taps son camiones o furgonetas modificados y son la forma más económica de viajar por Haití.
getting_around.quote: "Tap-taps" are the most economical way to travel in Haiti.

getting_around.en: In Port-au-Prince most tap-tap routes cost 10 gourdes, and you shout "merci!" to make the driver stop.
getting_around.es: En Puerto Príncipe la mayoría de rutas de tap-tap cuestan 10 gourdes, y se grita "merci!" para que el conductor pare.
getting_around.quote: In Port-au-Prince, most routes cost 10 gourdes ($0.25).

getting_around.en: Tap-taps are sometimes overpacked and can be quite dangerous on mountain roads.
getting_around.es: Los tap-taps a veces van sobrecargados y pueden ser bastante peligrosos en carreteras de montaña.
getting_around.quote: they are sometimes overpacked and can be quite dangerous to ride in the mountain roads

getting_around.en: Minibuses are a more comfortable alternative for long-distance travel, with a seat to Jacmel costing about 150 gourdes.
getting_around.es: Los minibuses son una alternativa más cómoda para largas distancias, con un asiento a Jacmel por unos 150 gourdes.
getting_around.quote: A more comfortable alternative for long distance travel are minibuses.

money.en: The currency is the Haitian gourde (HTG), but virtually everything is priced in Haitian dollars, equal to 5 gourdes.
money.es: La moneda es la gourde haitiana (HTG), pero casi todo se cotiza en dólares haitianos, equivalentes a 5 gourdes.
money.quote: virtually everything is priced in "dollars" — not US but Haitian dollars, equivalent to 5 gourdes.

money.en: Haggling is wise and recommended in markets, as most Haitians will charge foreigners at least double the market rate.
money.es: Regatear es aconsejable en los mercados, ya que la mayoría de los haitianos cobra a los extranjeros al menos el doble.
money.quote: Haggling is both wise and recommended, as most Haitians will charge foreigners at least double the market rate.

money.es: Los billetes son de 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 y 1.000 gourdes.
money.quote: Banknotes of Haiti are issued in denominations of 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 and 1,000 gourdes.

money.en: Travellers should take care when withdrawing money at public ATMs and use supermarkets or hotels with security guards.
money.es: Hay que tener cuidado al retirar dinero en cajeros públicos y usar supermercados u hoteles con guardias de seguridad.
money.quote: Take care when withdrawing money at public ATMs and use supermarkets or hotels with security guards.

etiquette.en: Haiti has fairly conservative norms, and modest dress is advised in cities, especially for women.
etiquette.es: Haití tiene normas bastante conservadoras y se aconseja vestir con modestia en las ciudades, sobre todo las mujeres.
etiquette.quote: Haiti is a nation of fairly conservative norms. Modest dress when exploring Haiti's cities is advised, especially for women.

etiquette.en: Ask permission before taking pictures of locals, who often ask for money.
etiquette.es: Pide permiso antes de fotografiar a los locales, que a menudo piden dinero.
etiquette.quote: Ask permission before taking pictures of locals (they often ask you for money).

etiquette.en: Handing out candy or dollar bills is offensive to most people as it compromises the dignity of Haitians.
etiquette.es: Repartir caramelos o billetes es ofensivo para la mayoría porque compromete la dignidad de los haitianos.
etiquette.quote: this is offensive to most people as it compromises the dignity of Haitians.

etiquette.en: Visitors should be patient, as nothing moves fast in Haiti and complaining can be insulting.
etiquette.es: Hay que tener paciencia, ya que nada va rápido en Haití y quejarse puede resultar insultante.
etiquette.quote: Be patient as nothing moves fast in Haiti.

etiquette.en: Attitudes to the LGBT+ community are hostile among many Haitians, and showing affection in public could draw unwanted attention.
etiquette.es: La actitud de muchos haitianos hacia la comunidad LGBT+ es hostil, y mostrar afecto en público podría atraer atención negativa.
etiquette.quote: showing affection in public could result in unwanted and negative attention.
